lesson_text: DD 8/20 overlay on C19+L22 blend reduces MDD from 47.6% to 32.0% (hard fail -> pass) but cuts CAGR from 20.1% to 12.9% and SR from 0.927 to 0.834. The 8% short-term DD threshold is too aggressive — it triggers frequently during normal volatility, eroding returns disproportionately. Wider thresholds (e.g., 10/25) or combining DD with Regime overlay preserves more alpha. DD overlay alone is a blunt instrument.
